**Parent:** LP-0MU3VDB9U008H8CI (When a request cannot be processed because there are no available models include a retry timer)
**Type:** task · **Priority:** medium

## Problem

The proxy emits a truthful multi-hour `Retry-After` on the "All providers
exhausted" 503. Whether that timer is actually honoured depends on the
ContextHub client, which previously clamped every applied `Retry-After` to
60 s. The linked client item WL-0MUR5EGH7003VOHM was created for that gap
(producer decision Q3a). The proxy item must record the cross-link and verify
that the client-side honouring landed, so the composed contract is
demonstrably intact from the client's perspective.

## Change

Record and verify the cross-repository link: confirm the ContextHub change
honours long server hints and record the evidence (file/line/default plus its
tests) on this work item. Do not edit the ContextHub repository from this
item; if a residual client gap remains, raise a new linked work item instead.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC6 — Client gap linked:** The ContextHub item WL-0MUR5EGH7003VOHM exists and
  is referenced from this item, so the proxy's honest multi-hour timer can be
  honoured by the client rather than clamped to 60 s.
- The cross-link comment on this work item records the client-side evidence: `packages/tui/extensions/Worklog/lib/recovery/retry-logic.ts` exposes `serverHintMaxDelayMs` (default 6 h) and no longer clamps a server hint to `maxDelayMs`, with covering tests named.
- Any residual client-side gap is raised as a new work item and recorded as a blocking/related link (not silently folded into this item).

## Minimal implementation

- Inspect the ContextHub recovery module and record the exact file, symbol, default value and covering test names as evidence.
- Add a comment on `LP-0MU3VDB9U008H8CI` with the cross-references and evidence, and the outcome of the verification (gap closed / residual gap).
- Confirm the ContextHub item in `WL-0MUR5EGH7003VOHM` already references this proxy item; add a reciprocal note only if the item is still open.

## Dependencies

- None (cross-repository evidence gathering); may proceed in parallel with the test item.

## Key Files

- ContextHub `packages/tui/extensions/Worklog/lib/recovery/retry-logic.ts` — `serverHintMaxDelayMs`, `calculateDelay` (read-only, not edited here).
- ContextHub `packages/tui/extensions/Worklog/lib/recovery/retry-after.test.ts` — long-hint coverage (read-only).
- `proxy/README.md` — referencing doc target for the client expectation (owned by the docs sibling item).

## Deliverables

- A verification comment on this work item with the cross-links and quoted client evidence.
data.title: Cross-link and verify ContextHub long Retry-After honouring

# Parse attribution markers in log_parser.py

## Goal

Teach `log_parser.py` to parse the actor/source attribution markers
added by **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** into structured fields on restart and
mode-switch LogEvents, degrading gracefully when markers are absent.

## Scope

- Add two new fields to `LogEvent`: `source` (str | None) and `actor`
  (str | None). The existing `reason` field is reused to carry the
  attribution `reason=` value on restart/mode-switch events (it is
  currently always `None` for these kinds, so reuse is backward compatible).
- Parse `source=scheduler|worker|api|manual` from:
  - `Mode-switch restart spawned:` lines (attribution appended at
    `set_mode()` time)
  - Mode-switch lines (`Mode scheduler: applied scheduled mode ...` and
    `Grandfathering: enabled; ...`)
  - The `start-proxy.sh --restart` startup attribution line (reason echoed
    into the new process startup log before the `Starting LLama Proxy Server`
    marker)
- Parse `actor=<name>` and `reason=<text>` from the same lines.
- When markers are absent, the fields remain `None` (existing behaviour
  preserved).
- Add tolerant regex extractors (`source=`, `actor=`, `reason=`) so any
  future key=value attribution fields are easy to add.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `log_parser.py` parses the new attribution markers into structured
      fields on the restart/mode-switch events (absent markers degrade
      gracefully to the current behaviour).
- [ ] `LogEvent.source` / `LogEvent.actor` are populated and `LogEvent.reason`
      carries the attribution reason when markers are present on restart and
      mode-switch lines.
- [ ] When markers are absent, the new fields default to `None` (backward
      compatible; existing tests unchanged).
- [ ] A tolerant regex pattern extracts `source=`, `actor=`, and `reason=`
      from arbitrary log lines.
- [ ] Unit tests cover: markers present on spawned/complete/startup lines,
      markers absent (historical log), missing individual keys.
- [ ] No regression in existing log-line parsing (all existing tests still pass).

## Key Files

- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/log_parser.py`
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py`

## Dependencies

- **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** — the attribution markers must be produced by
  the proxy first; verify the exact landed marker format before finalising
  the extractors.
data.title: Parse attribution markers in log_parser.py
